instruction: You are a strategic corporate innovation advisor. Analyse the company profile and survey responses, then respond ONLY with a valid JSON object containing maturity_score, opportunities, next_steps, and key_weaknesses.

answers.companyDescription: Prime Labs is a focused insurance brokerage firm providing comprehensive risk management consulting for corporate clients across property, casualty, cyber, and D&O lines. The team of 35 brokers manages approximately €60M in placed premiums, specializing in complex risk exposure modeling. They operate from a centralized hub with localized service departments.
answers.pastInitiatives: Our engineering team successfully adopted an agile methodology last year, transitioning from quarterly waterfall releases to 2-week sprints and continuous deployment cycles. This initiative increased development velocity by 60% but has highlighted a need for better communication channels between the technical dev team and client-facing operations.
answers.strategicGoals: We operate in a consolidating market where larger competitors are merging, making our independent position increasingly vulnerable to scale. Our goal is to proactively strengthen competitive positioning by either deepening our specialization in high-margin niches or building platform-like switching costs that make our core risk analytics offering indispensable.
answers.additionalContext: The firm is currently facing intense pressure from large carriers offering bundled services. They need to transition from reactive risk advisory to proactive, data-driven predictive modeling to justify premium pricing and retention.
answers.teamSize: The innovation function is informal — one senior engineer has been given permission to spend 20% of their time exploring new technologies and prototyping ideas, but this allocation is frequently interrupted by production incidents and urgent feature requests. We have no dedicated innovation budget beyond standard cloud infrastructure costs.

opportunities.title: Automated Data Normalization Pipeline (Quick Win)
opportunities.rationale: Implementing an automated pipeline for normalizing disparate client data will streamline the risk assessment process and significantly reduce manual input errors. This is a foundational step toward improving efficiency without requiring major platform overhaul.

first_actions: Identify 3 high-friction data points (e.g., loss history entry)
Pilot integration with existing CRM tool
resources_needed: License for basic ETL tool (e.g., Python/Pandas libraries)
execution_plan.success_metric: 30% reduction in data entry error rate within Q2.

opportunities.title: Proprietary Risk Prediction Engine Platform
opportunities.rationale: Develop a proprietary ML model that moves beyond simple exposure modeling to provide predictive risk scores for specific cyber and property events. This would create high switching costs by embedding Prime Labs' unique historical data directly into their platform.

first_actions: Allocate 20% dedicated time to model exploration
Acquire or build specialized cloud infrastructure for ML training
execution_plan.success_metric: Achieve 90% accuracy in predicting property claims likelihood within 12 months.
milestones: MVP model deployment and internal testing (Month 6)
Beta launch with top 5 corporate clients (Month 8)

opportunities.title: Targeted Niche Content & Data Monetization
opportunities.rationale: Leverage dedicated research capabilities to create premium, specialized risk reports for a high-margin niche (e.g., specific industrial cyber risks). This directly supports market defense by focusing on areas where the firm can win against scale.

first_actions: Conduct gap analysis of current research output
Secure partnership with one industry-specific consultancy
Design a subscription tier for specialized reports
execution_plan.success_metric: Convert 10% of research clients to paying subscribers within the fiscal year.
milestones: Identify and launch first niche report series (Month 3)

next_steps.action: Establish a dedicated, small 'Risk Science Squad' with clear KPIs and budget.
Execute the quick win for data normalization using existing engineering resources.

key_weaknesses: Lack of formalized, dedicated innovation budget beyond minimal operational costs.
High dependency on a single senior engineer for all prototyping and experimentation.
Slow internal communication between the technical team (agile sprints) and non-technical teams (marketing/support).
Fragmented innovation process that lacks standardized intake or prioritization criteria.
